chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou deal with the aftermath of their intimate encounter. Gu Suizhou, feeling insecure and possessive, handcuffs Shen Feizhi to a nightstand before leaving for work. Shen Feizhi, needing to investigate his and Gu Suizhou's abnormal physical states, manages to bring the nightstand handle with him to meet his associate, C2. They visit a private hospital owned by Professor Ritter to analyze Shen Feizhi's pheromones. Meanwhile, Gu Suizhou grows suspicious of Shen Feizhi's whereabouts after receiving a tip from Ritter, leading to a tense exchange of messages between the two.

new_characters.name: C2
new_characters.description: An associate of Shen Feizhi who helps him investigate the 'Main Star' and pheromone anomalies. He is currently posing as a department director at a private hospital.

new_characters.name: Professor Ritter
new_characters.description: A professor who knows Shen Feizhi and owns the private hospital where C2 is currently operating. He is acquainted with Gu Suizhou.
